rule_set.rule: Existing direct SQL reader, never a manual CSV or alternate importer.
Identity uses typed source keys, never names/fuzzy matches.
WKSDetail sale and purchase actual quantities and amounts govern imported historical transaction economics.
Original PODetail.Weight/WeightUOM quantity placeholders are excluded from imported historical commercial quantities.
WKSDetail.SPO_ID/PPO_ID -> PODetail.PO_ID (line key), not PO.POID (header key).
Preserve multiple worksheets per order and a worksheet with multiple order parents.
QuickBooks owns historical payment execution, receipt settlement and paid-status truth. No reconstruction from ERP payment flags.
Historical commissions dated before 2026-06-01 must display paid/settled with zero amount due and no generated payout or bank movement.
Commission rows on/after 2026-06-01 remain unresolved for payout unless separately reconciled. Null/ambiguous dates do not auto-settle.
Use BuySell stored slot recipient and commission amount, no fallback to current partner rep and no recomputation.
Exclude all PrepayLedger rows and PayablesBatch.PrePay=1 from financial object creation; preserve ordinary linked business data.
One approved sales credit -> one credit object; paired zero-sum transfer is not an additional bank line or second credit.
No false current A/R, A/P, cash, revenue or cost in post-cutover Odoo books.
Only an explicitly proven disposable Odoo DB may receive verification writes.
Second import on same source snapshot creates zero duplicate source identities or economic churn.
Partition source records by imported, explicitly excluded, unresolved, or nonapplicable; no silent loss.
No automated payout or historical Odoo bank payment from SQL fields.
SQL report evidence is not ORM execution proof or external bank verification.
Do not project SO Reserve-tab properties or logistics-only worksheet checkboxes.
